findings.fix: Delete the declaration (and the PR-description bullet). Its only use, the calc step at line ~244 `(Polynomial.aeval_eq_eval (v j) q).symm`, becomes `(congrFun (Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval (v j)) q).symm`, or just `rfl`/`simp` since the Mathlib lemma is `rfl`.
findings.issue: `Polynomial.aeval_eq_eval` is not "previously missing": Mathlib has `Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval (r : R) : (aeval r : R[X] → R) = eval r` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/AlgebraMap.lean:475`, `@[simp]`, proof `rfl`), which directly replaces it.

findings.evidence: Line 162 `rw [aeval_eq_eval]` elaborates before line 167, so it resolves via `open _root_.MvPolynomial` to Mathlib's lemma; the file therefore uses the library lemma and the duplicate of it.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Monad.lean:68 def bind₁ (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) := aeval f`, with `aeval_bind₁`, `rename_bind₁`, `bind₁_rename` at :255, :209, :224.
findings.fix: Define `substVar q := bind₁ fun i => Polynomial.aeval (X i) q`. Then `aeval_substVar` follows from `MvPolynomial.aeval_bind₁` (Monad.lean:255) plus `Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply`, and `IsSymmetric.substVar` from `rename_bind₁` (:209) and `bind₁_rename` (:224): `rename e (bind₁ g p) = bind₁ (fun i => rename e (g i)) p = bind₁ (g ∘ e) p = bind₁ g (rename e p) = bind₁ g p`, dropping the `have h : ... .comp ... = ... .comp ...` block.
findings.issue: `MvPolynomial.substVar q` is `MvPolynomial.bind₁ (fun i => Polynomial.aeval (X i) q)` — a specialization of the existing combinator, defined instead through raw `aeval`, so none of the `bind₁` API applies. In particular `IsSymmetric.substVar` (line 102) hand-rolls the `rename`/substitution commutation with `algHom_ext`.

summary: Two new declarations are directly replaced by existing Mathlib lemmas (`Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval`, `MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_eval` — the latter already used elsewhere in the same file), and the Vieta helper re-proves `TauCeti.Sym.coeff_toMonic`. The final analyticity step and the `substVar` definition also bypass located Mathlib API (`AnalyticOnNhd.eval_mvPolynomial`, `bind₁`).
